sections.section: RULE - Medical and Dental Council Regulations 2007
sections.description:
MEDICAL AND DENTAL COUNCIL REGULATIONS, 2007
MEDICAL
AND DENTAL COUNCIL REGULATIONS, 2007
(Amendments)
[Gazette
of Pakistan, Extraordinary Part II,
2nd December, 2010]
S.R.O.136(KE)/2010, dated
15-11-2010.---In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection (1) of section
33 of the Medical and Dental Council Ordinance, 1962 (Ord. XXXII of 1962), the
Medical and Dental Council, with the previous sanction of the Federal
Government is pleased to direct that, in the Medical and Dental Council
Regulations, 2007, the following amendments shall be made namely;--
2. In the aforesaid Regulations,
(i) in regulation 2, in sub-regulation
(1),--
(a) clauses (d), (e) and (f) shall be
re-lettered as clauses (f), (d) and (e) respectively;
(b) in clause (e), re-lettered as
aforesaid, the word and shall be omitted;
(c) in clause (g),---
(i) for the full stop a semicolon shall
be substituted; and
(ii) after sub-clause (g) amended as
aforesaid, the following new clauses (h) and (i) shall be added, namely:--
(h) Secretary means the Secretary
appointed under subsection (1) of section 9 of the Ordinance; and
(i) Treasurer means the Treasurer
appointed under subsection (1) of section 9 of the Ordinance. ;
(ii) in regulation 52, after the comma,
the words and comma Secretary, Treasurer shall be inserted;
(iii) in regulation 54.---
(a) after the word or the commas and
words at their option, shall be inserted; and
(b) the comma and words, whichever is
earlier shall be omitted;
(iv) in regulation 55, after the word
of the words and comma Secretary, Treasurer and shall be inserted;
(v) in regulation 59,--
(a) for the word Council occurring for
the fourth time, the words President of the Council shall be substituted; and
(b) for the word Registrar the word
Treasurer shall be substituted;
(vi) in regulation 60, for the word
Registrar the word Treasurer shall be substituted;
(vii) in regulation 61,--
(a) for the word Registrar , wherever
occurring, the word Treasurer shall be
substituted; and
(b) after the full stop at the end, the words
and full stop All investment shall be made in consultation with the Treasurer
shall be added;
(viii) in regulation 62, for the word
Registrar the word Treasurer shall be substituted;
(ix) in regulation 63, after the word
Registrar the words or Secretary shall be inserted;
(x) for regulation 64, the following
shall be substituted, namely:--
64.
Units of appropriation.--The primary units of appropriation shall be of
establishment charges, purchase and repair of furniture, fixture and fitting,
audit and legal fee, purchase, repair and maintenance of machinery and
equipments, meeting expenses, expenses relating to regional offices, utilities,
commodities and services, repair and
maintenance of building of headquarter, printing publication and stationery
expenses, advertisement expenses, postage and telegraph expenses, pay and
allowances, travelling and daily allowance for officers and office holders,
examiners, inspectors or members, miscellaneous expenses and contingencies. ;
(xi)
in regulation 66,---
(a)
after the word Registrar the words or Secretary shall be inserted;
(b)
for the word ten the word fifty shall be substituted; and
(c)
for the words two hundred thousand the words one million shall be
substituted;
(xii)
for regulation 67, the following shall be substituted, namely:--
67.
Advance Payment.--Each of the Registrar and Secretary shall have an
imprest money of rupees fifty thousand and in charge of regional office for a
special project shall have an imprest money of rupees twenty thousand.
(xiii)
In regulation 69, for the word Registrar the word Treasurer shall be
substituted; and
(xiv)
in regulation 70, after the word Registrar wherever occurring, the words or
Treasury shall be inserted.
